name: filter a large dataset to a given locale subset and export columns to jsonl
definition: load a dataset, keep only rows of one locale, and emit the required columns as newline-delimited JSON with the exact row count and column names.
failure_mode: a different locale subset or wrong row count/columns fails the format assertions

name: filter and rank candidates by proximity to a target property value
definition: Combine lookup+parsing+descriptors to return molecules within a tolerance of a target descriptor, sorted by a proximately score, with a justification/normalization reporting field.
failure_mode: Missing fields, unsorted, wrong tolerance handling, or mismatched actual target descriptor.

name: fix cython source for numpy 2.x api compatibility
definition: Adapt the cython/cython-adjacent source so its build works against an existing newer numpy and no longer uses removed or changed legacy numpy C API.
failure_mode: Build fails or imports crash due to stale numpy API usage.

name: generate and protect a 2048-bit rsa private key
definition: produce a 2048-bit rsa private key file and set a private access mode on it.
failure_mode: wrong key length or overly open permissions fails the key checks
